svg.title: OpenAct: one Rules node plants a whole terrain
svg.desc: A Rules node in the Geometry Nodes editor, asked 'Which plant grows here?', reads the temperature, moisture and altitude of every point of a terrain and gives each point its plant: pines below the mountain's rock and snow, birches on its cold lower slopes, heather on the cold dry hills, olives on mild dry ground, oaks in the mild wet lowland, palms in the hot wet lowland and cacti in the hot dry desert.
